say:1:1064101001:0.text: Today's prayer ends here. May Dura's Divine Light shine on you always.
say:1:1064101001:0.source_cn: 今日祷告至此结束。愿艾雅的圣光永远照耀着你们。

say:2:1064101002:1.text: Dura above. Your words have brought us peace.
say:2:1064101002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，感谢您的布道。

say:4:1064101003:1.text: It's getting late. Let's head home.
say:4:1064101003:1.source_cn: 时间不早了。咱们也回家吧。

say:5:1064101004:1.text: Alright. Kirako, make sure you say goodbye.
say:5:1064101004:1.source_cn: 好。吉拉科，记得要和修士修女们告别哦。

say:9:1064101006:0.source_cn: 康塔格修士，艾达姐姐，再见！

say:13:1064101008:1.text: Lively and lovely as ever, that one.
say:13:1064101008:1.source_cn: 吉拉科还是那么有活力。

say:14:1064101009:1.text: Heh. Peace like this doesn't happen by chance. Ensar's been kept under Dura's light, and the Temple's care.
say:14:1064101009:1.source_cn: 呵呵，恩莎村能拥有这样和平宁静的时光，都是仰赖女神与圣...

say:15:1064101010:1.text: Ada, have you noticed? Even a remote village like ours has had new faces coming in. Could be merchants, looking to trade.
say:15:1064101010:1.source_cn: 艾达修女，你没有发现吗？连我们这样偏僻的小村庄，最近都...

say:17:1064101012:1.text: Naturally. Ever since the Second Divine War, we haven't had new settlers in ages.
say:17:1064101012:1.source_cn: 当然。自从第二次神魔大战结束，已经接近十年没有外来者来...

say:18:1064101013:0.text: Dura above. Please watch over Ensar and bless us with prosperity.
say:18:1064101013:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，愿您永远庇佑恩莎村，让这里更加繁荣一些吧。

say:23:1064101015:1.text: Ada, you've been distracted all evening. Something happened?
say:23:1064101015:1.source_cn: 艾达修女，你一直心不在焉。出什么事了？

say:24:1064101016:1.text: I heard... there've been a lot of outsiders in the village lately.
say:24:1064101016:1.source_cn: 我听说……最近有很多生面孔来到了村里。

say:25:1064101017:1.text: Could it mean war again, somewhere maybe? What if another Divine War is coming?
say:25:1064101017:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女，会不会是哪里又发生了战争？就像十年前的神魔...

say:26:1064101018:1.text: I can't rule that out, I'm afraid.

say:27:1064101019:1.text: I know how you feel, Ada. That war left you with scars that don't fade easily.
say:27:1064101019:1.source_cn: 我明白你的担忧，艾达修女。十年前的战争，给你留下了可怕...

say:28:1064101020:1.text: But look, war hasn't reached Ensar. It's likely only a minor riot in the neighboring towns, if anything. It'll settle soon, so don't let fear take root.
say:28:1064101020:1.source_cn: 但你看，没有战火蔓延到恩莎村，很可能只是临近的村镇发生...

say:29:1064101021:1.text: I know... It's just... I'm worried refugees might bring danger to Ensar with them.
say:29:1064101021:1.source_cn: 我明白……我只是担心，战争难民逃亡过来，会不会给恩莎村...

say:30:1064101022:1.text: Don't worry. We'll find a way to protect anyone who seeks the temple's assistance.
say:30:1064101022:1.source_cn: 呵呵，不用担心。如果难民向教堂求助，我们自然有办法提供庇护。

say:31:1064101023:0.text: Even that unremarkable cabinet proved its worth. Ten years ago, it hid someone from an enemy search.
say:31:1064101023:0.source_cn: 比如，那只最不起眼的橱柜。十年前，就曾有人藏在里面躲避...

say:33:1064101024:0.text: The one that barely fits two sacks of grain? It's so cramped. How could anyone hide in there?
say:33:1064101024:0.source_cn: 那个只能勉强装入两袋麦谷的小橱柜吗？里面那么狭窄，难民...

say:35:1064101025:1.text: In the face of death, something in us awakens.
say:35:1064101025:1.source_cn: 在求生时，人的潜能是无限的。

say:36:1064101026:1.text: Even with two sacks in there, one can wedge themselves into the space that's left when it comes to it.
say:36:1064101026:1.source_cn: 当危机真正来临，即使橱柜里已经装进了两袋麦谷，难民也能...

say:37:1064101027:1.text: I'll show you every shelter in the temple. Age is catching up with me. It's only a matter of time before you and Acolyte Contag take over.
say:37:1064101027:1.source_cn: 之后，我会将教堂内的藏身之处都告诉你。我的年纪愈发大了...

say:38:1064101028:1.text: Remember Dura's teachings. Remember the Temple's most sacred creed: to give shelter to those who suffer.
say:38:1064101028:1.source_cn: 你们要铭记女神的教导，铭记圣堂最重要的教义：为遭受磨难...

say:39:1064101029:1.text: I'll bear that in mind. Thank you.
say:39:1064101029:1.source_cn: 谢谢您的教导，我记住了。

say:40:1064101030:1.text: I will offer shelter to any refugee who comes to us with an open heart and gratitude to Dura, and I will pray for her grace.
say:40:1064101030:1.source_cn: 如果遇到战争难民，我会怀着对艾雅女神的感恩之心庇护他们...

say:42:1064101032:1.text: Night has fallen. Eat something, then have a good night's rest.
say:42:1064101032:1.source_cn: 夜幕已经降临。用完晚餐就回房休息吧。

say:43:1064101033:1.text: Worry not. Dura will always keep the faithful safe.
say:43:1064101033:1.source_cn: 无需再担忧，艾雅女神会永远庇护着祂虔诚的信徒。

narration:45:1064101034:0.text: As the night grows darker, Ada drifts to sleep with gratitude.
narration:45:1064101034:0.source_cn: 夜色愈深，艾达怀着感恩之心渐渐入睡

narration:46:1064101035:0.text: ...until the next morning, when a scream shatters Ensar's peace.
narration:46:1064101035:0.source_cn: 直到第二天清晨，一道哭喊划破了恩莎村的宁静

say:49:1064101036:1.text: H-Help! Anyone? Please help my dad! *Crying*
say:49:1064101036:1.source_cn: 救、救命！救救……救救我爸爸！呜呜呜——！

say:51:1064101037:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！吉拉科，发生了什么事？

say:52:1064101038:1.text: My dad... He... blood... everywhere... Bad guy...
say:52:1064101038:1.source_cn: 爸爸……爸爸他……血……好多血……坏人……

say:53:1064101039:0.text: Easy, boy. Take a deep breath. What happened to your father? And the bad guy?
say:53:1064101039:0.source_cn: 好孩子，别哭，慢慢说。你爸爸怎么了，哪里有坏人？

say:54:1064101040:1.text: Someone... broke into our house. Dad tried to protect me and Mom, and then... then...
say:54:1064101040:1.source_cn: 有、坏人……闯进了我家。爸爸想保护我和妈妈……然后就、就……

say:56:1064101042:0.text: Who is that bad guy? An outsider?

say:58:1064101043:0.text: Ada, not now! Go get hemostatic potions. We're going to the Lero house!
say:58:1064101043:0.source_cn: 艾达修女！现在不是说这些的时候！快拿上止血的药剂，我们...

say:0:1064102001:2.text: Blinding morning light spills into the room, revealing the mess... and Lero lying in a pool of blood.
say:0:1064102001:2.source_cn: 刺目的晨光映入屋内，照出了满地狼藉，以及躺在血泊中的列罗。

say:1:1064102002:1.text: Eminie kneels beside him in the shadow, trembling uncontrollably. A vial shakes in her hand as she tries to press it to his lips.
say:1:1064102002:1.source_cn: 埃米妮跪在他身旁的阴影里，止不住地战栗着，拿着一瓶药似...

say:2:1064102003:1.text: It does nothing. No rise and fall of Lero's chest. No miracles.
say:2:1064102003:1.source_cn: 可惜，那没有任何作用。列罗的胸口早已没了起伏的迹象。

say:4:1064102004:1.text: Lero... Lero, please stay with me. I... I can save you.
say:4:1064102004:1.source_cn: 列罗……列罗，坚持住。我……我一定能救你……

say:6:1064102005:1.text: Dad... Dad, wake up! I brought the acolytes! Th-The... Goddess will protect you!
say:6:1064102005:1.source_cn: 爸爸……爸爸醒一醒！我把修女们找来了，神……神一定会庇...

say:11:1064102009:1.text: I'm sorry, Eminie. We didn't make it in time.
say:11:1064102009:1.source_cn: 抱歉，埃米妮，我们没能及时赶到。

say:12:1064102010:1.text: Lero... He is gone. Let go of his hand and allow him to return to Dura's side. Or he may linger, worried for you and Kirako.
say:12:1064102010:1.source_cn: 列罗……他已经离去。请放开他的手，让他回到艾雅身边，不...

say:14:1064102011:1.text: No, no, no... It can't be true... My Lero, he wouldn't...
say:14:1064102011:1.source_cn: 不，不，怎么可能……列罗他不会死的！

say:15:1064102012:1.text: The potion... It is supposed to save him! Why won't it work?
say:15:1064102012:1.source_cn: 这瓶药……这瓶药明明能救他，为什么不起作用？！

say:16:1064102013:1.text: It can't be real... We had a life planned. How can he leave me behind? Why...?
say:16:1064102013:1.source_cn: 我不相信……他怎么可能会死？我们明明约定过要共度一生…...

say:17:1064102014:1.text: I know how much you hurt, Eminie.
say:17:1064102014:1.source_cn: 是的，是的……我明白你的痛苦，埃米妮。

say:18:1064102015:1.text: Let it all out... Everything will be all right...
say:18:1064102015:1.source_cn: 哭出来吧。哭出来，一切都会慢慢好起来……

say:20:1064102016:1.text: You need tending as well, Eminie.

say:21:1064102017:1.text: You have to hold on... Your son still needs you.
say:21:1064102017:1.source_cn: ……也请振作一点吧。无论如何，你还有吉拉科。

say:24:1064102019:1.source_cn: 吉拉科……我可怜的孩子……呜……

say:26:1064102020:1.text: Dura above. What an unfortunate tragedy.
say:26:1064102020:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，多么可怜的一对母子……

say:27:1064102021:1.text: Louisa, what do we do now? And the murderer—where to start?
say:27:1064102021:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女，列罗的后事该怎么办？还有杀害他的真凶，该怎...

say:28:1064102022:1.text: Bring Lero's body to the temple with Eminie and Kirako. Acolytes will prepare the funeral. I'll stay here and look for anything left behind.
say:28:1064102022:1.source_cn: 你先陪埃米妮和吉拉科将列罗的遗体运到教堂吧，修士们会为...

say:29:1064102023:1.text: If we can't put a name to the killer yet, the village needs to know immediately. Tell them to lock up and stay alert.
say:29:1064102023:1.source_cn: 如果暂时无法确定凶手的身份，这件事也必须尽早通知各位村...

say:32:1064102025:0.text: How about the potion Eminie tried to give him? Should I bring it too? The pattern on the vial looks... strange.
say:32:1064102025:0.source_cn: 埃米妮喂给列罗的这瓶药要不要一起带回教堂？瓶身上的印记...

say:33:1064102026:0.text: Leave it here. We need to make sure the scene is not tampered with.
say:33:1064102026:0.source_cn: 暂时留在这里吧，不要破坏周围的痕迹。

say:35:1064102027:1.text: The cruel reality left Eminie in shock. She was just desperate to bring him back.
say:35:1064102027:1.source_cn: 我想，埃米妮只是一时无法接受列罗的离去，才会绞尽脑汁地...

narration:37:1064102028:0.text: Ada stays by the mother and child as they carry Lero back to the temple.
narration:37:1064102028:0.source_cn: 艾达陪伴着母子俩，将列罗的遗体运回了教堂

narration:38:1064102029:0.source_cn: 不久之后，路易莎也匆匆返回

say:41:1064102030:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女，您有找到凶手留下的线索吗？

say:42:1064102031:1.text: It happened before dawn. No one around the Lero house saw the attacker.
say:42:1064102031:1.source_cn: 事发时天还未亮，列罗家周围的村民都没有看到凶手逃往了何处。

say:43:1064102032:1.text: I've sent word to the town and requested guards to investigate.
say:43:1064102032:1.source_cn: 我已经派人去镇上通报此事，请求守卫前来调查了。

say:46:1064102034:1.text: Louisa, please talk to Eminie. She won't listen to us. She's only been crying...
say:46:1064102034:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女，请您劝劝埃米妮吧。无论我和康塔格修士说什么...

say:47:1064102035:1.text: *Sigh* I'll see what I can do.

say:49:1064102036:1.text: Eminie... what you're feeling is only natural. But we need you to tell us what you saw this morning, even if it hurts.
say:49:1064102036:1.source_cn: 埃米妮，我知道你此刻还沉浸在悲伤之中，让你回忆今早的事...

say:50:1064102037:1.source_cn: 你有没有看清，袭击列罗的人长什么样？

say:53:1064102039:1.text: Be strong. We can't avenge Lero unless we catch the one who did this.
say:53:1064102039:1.source_cn: 请振作一点。只有抓到凶手，我们才能替列罗报仇。

say:54:1064102040:1.text: Contag is right. We must bring the murderer to justice. And now, Eminie... only you can help us and help Lero.
say:54:1064102040:1.source_cn: 是的，造成这一切的歹徒应当受到惩罚。现在只有你能帮助我...

say:57:1064102042:1.text: He... He was tall. And with long hair...
say:57:1064102042:1.source_cn: 袭击列罗的那个人，个子很高，头发也有些长……

say:58:1064102043:1.text: I think... I think he had blue eyes. It was so dark... I barely saw anything...
say:58:1064102043:1.source_cn: 好像……好像是是蓝眼睛。那时候天色太暗，我只是模模糊糊...

say:59:1064102044:1.text: Did he say anything? Anything that suggests where he went?
say:59:1064102044:1.source_cn: 凶手可有说过什么？我们或许能推测出他之后的去向。

say:61:1064102046:1.text: He said nothing. Never mind... It's all my fault!
say:61:1064102046:1.source_cn: ……不，他什么也没说……总之，总之都是我的错！是我的错！！

say:62:1064102047:1.text: I should have known better—happiness was never meant for me! If I hadn't insisted on staying here, Lero wouldn't have died!
say:62:1064102047:1.source_cn: 要不是我来了恩莎村，要不是我奢望幸福，要不是我赖在这儿...

say:64:1064102048:1.text: Don't carry a burden that isn't yours. You never saw it coming.
say:64:1064102048:1.source_cn: 埃米妮，请不要自责，列罗的离去只是一个意外，和你没有关系。

say:65:1064102049:1.text: No! You don't get it! It's all my fault!
say:65:1064102049:1.source_cn: 不，你不明白……这就是我的错！！

say:70:1064102052:1.text: Ada, take Kirako outside. Get him some air. Acolyte Contag and I will handle this.
say:70:1064102052:1.source_cn: 艾达修女，你先带吉拉科出去透透气。这里交给我和康塔格修士。

say:71:1064102053:1.text: Some words are too heavy for a child.
say:71:1064102053:1.source_cn: 有些话，不适合让孩子们听到。

narration:74:1064102055:0.text: Ada leads Kirako out to a quiet spot beside the temple.
narration:74:1064102055:0.source_cn: 艾达牵着吉拉科来到教堂外的安静之处

say:78:1064102057:1.text: Ada... Why did Mom say that?
say:78:1064102057:1.source_cn: 艾达姐姐，为什么……为什么我妈妈会说那样的话？

say:79:1064102058:1.text: And my dad... Will he ever come back?
say:79:1064102058:1.source_cn: 还有爸爸……他真的再也不会回来了吗？

say:80:1064102059:1.text: He is with Dura now. He'll find peace there.
say:80:1064102059:1.source_cn: ……他已经回归了女神的天国，他会在那里获得安息。

say:81:1064102060:1.text: Your mother got a terrible shock. She just needs more time.
say:81:1064102060:1.source_cn: 至于你母亲，她只是受到的打击太大，一时无法接受现实。

say:82:1064102061:1.text: Be strong and stay with her through this, alright Kirako? She'll get better soon.
say:82:1064102061:1.source_cn: 如果你能坚强地陪伴她度过这段时间，她一定很快就能好起来...

say:83:1064102062:1.text: I... I will. Dad always told me I had to protect Mom...
say:83:1064102062:1.source_cn: 我……我知道。爸爸以前经常和我说，要保护妈妈……

say:84:1064102063:1.text: But the bad guy is still out there... What if he comes back and hurts Mom, too?
say:84:1064102063:1.source_cn: 可是，坏人还没有抓到……要是他还想伤害我妈妈，我该怎么办？

say:85:1064102064:1.text: How could he get away with it?
say:85:1064102064:1.source_cn: 坏人……为什么没有受到惩罚呢？

say:87:1064102066:1.text: Let me tell you a story, Kirako.
say:87:1064102066:1.source_cn: 吉拉科，我给你讲个故事吧。

say:89:1064102068:1.text: Have you ever heard of Athalia, Dura's Harbinger of Justice?
say:89:1064102068:1.source_cn: 你听说过侍奉艾雅的“天罚之刃”——阿塔利娅吗？

say:91:1064102070:1.text: According to the Temple Codex, Athalia is Dura's lance and the first Celestial given human form among the blessed.
say:91:1064102070:1.source_cn: 在圣典的记载中，阿塔利娅是艾雅女神的骑枪，也是第一位蒙...

say:92:1064102071:1.text: She is depicted as the justice itself, sworn to purge evil from the world.
say:92:1064102071:1.source_cn: 在传说中，她是嫉恶如仇的正义裁决者，肩负着肃清邪恶的使命。

say:93:1064102072:1.text: When the wicked harm the innocent, Lady Athalia will respond to those who pray to her with true faith and set things right. No sin escapes her.
say:93:1064102072:1.source_cn: 如果有人被恶人伤害，只要虔诚地向阿塔利娅大人祈祷，她就...

say:94:1064102073:1.text: Really? If I pray hard enough... the bad guy will be punished?
say:94:1064102073:1.source_cn: ……真的吗？只要虔诚地祈祷，坏人就能得到惩罚？

say:95:1064102074:1.text: Of course. Athalia will answer your prayer.
say:95:1064102074:1.source_cn: 当然，阿塔利娅大人可是正义的裁决者。

say:97:1064102076:1.text: Lady Athalia, please punish the bad guy in revenge for my dad!
say:97:1064102076:1.source_cn: 厉害的阿塔利娅大人，求您一定惩罚坏人，替我爸爸报仇！

say:99:1064102078:1.text: Ada, do you think Lady Athalia can hear me?
say:99:1064102078:1.source_cn: 艾达姐姐，这样做是不是阿塔利娅大人就能听见了？

say:101:1064102080:1.text: I'll tell Mom to pray with me, then! Lady Athalia will come down soon!
say:101:1064102080:1.source_cn: 那我也要告诉妈妈，让她也和我一起祈祷，这样阿塔利娅大人...

say:104:1064102083:1.text: Ten years since the Divine War ended... and yet the Celestials have shown themselves only rarely...
say:104:1064102083:1.source_cn: 战争结束已经十年了……这十年间，半神们现身的次数却寥寥...

say:105:1064102084:1.text: Lady Athalia... if a mortal's plea may reach you... please show them mercy and end the one who tore their family apart.
say:105:1064102084:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，若您能听到凡人的祈祷，祈求您怜悯这对可怜...

say:1:1064103001:1.text: So hungry... Good thing there's still some bread left.
say:1:1064103001:1.source_cn: 好饿……幸好晚餐时剩下了一些面包。

say:2:1064103002:1.text: Such gentle moonlight... It would've been another peaceful night if not for the tragedy.
say:2:1064103002:1.source_cn: 月色多么皎洁啊……如果没有发生那桩惨案，本该是宁静的一夜……

say:9:1064103005:1.text: It's coming from the cabinet. Could it be rats?
say:9:1064103005:1.source_cn: 好像是从那只橱柜里传出来的。难道有老鼠在偷吃？

say:10:1064103006:1.text: Oh, absolutely not. I need to chase them out.
say:10:1064103006:1.source_cn: 这可不行！我得把它们赶走。

narration:12:1064103007:1.text: Ada tiptoes to the cabinet and yanks the door open!

narration:13:1064103008:1.text: It's not a rat, but a man with a knife!

narration:27:1064103014:0.text: A beam of holy light slams down from above, cutting the villain's words short.
narration:27:1064103014:0.source_cn: 一道神光从天而降，终结了恶徒的话语

narration:28:1064103015:1.text: Trembling, Ada forces her eyes open... and the scene before her takes her breath away.

narration:29:1064103016:1.text: A shiny ivory lance pierces the attacker straight through his chest. He's dead before he hits the floor.

narration:30:1064103017:1.text: The lance is transformed into an ethereal woman, radiating sacred presence.

say:38:1064103022:1.text: Dura above. You are Lady Athalia!
say:38:1064103022:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……是、是阿塔利娅大人！

say:39:1064103023:1.text: Lady Athalia? The Harbinger of Justice?
say:39:1064103023:1.source_cn: 真、真的是阿塔利娅大人，传说中的天罚之刃……

say:43:1064103026:1.text: Yes! I found him hiding in the cabinet and he tried to kill me!
say:43:1064103026:1.source_cn: 是的！路易莎修女，他一直躲在橱柜里，被我发现后还想伤害我！

say:44:1064103027:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……这不是文森佐吗？！

say:46:1064103029:1.text: The temple took in many war refugees ten years ago. Vincenzo was one of them. He hid in this very cabinet.
say:46:1064103029:1.source_cn: 十年前，教堂曾收留过很多战争难民，文森佐就是其中之一。...

say:47:1064103030:1.text: He was no refugee. He was one of the Adamant Syndicate members, an outlaw who brings ruin wherever he goes.
say:47:1064103030:1.source_cn: 他不是战争难民，他是黑金商会的残党，四处为非作歹。

say:48:1064103031:0.text: Can't believe he joined the Syndicate...
say:48:1064103031:0.source_cn: 没想到，他竟然加入了黑金商会……

say:50:1064103032:0.text: I hope you don't mind me asking, but has he committed many crimes?
say:50:1064103032:0.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，请宽恕我的冒昧询问。他做了很多坏事吗？

say:51:1064103033:0.text: Yes. Such is the nature of the Adamant Syndicate.
say:51:1064103033:0.source_cn: 是。黑金商会成员皆是如此。

say:52:1064103034:1.text: His comrades have been erased under the name of justice. But this one dared to defile the Dura's refuge by hiding here! Unforgivable.
say:52:1064103034:1.source_cn: 其余同党都已被我裁决。而他，竟敢躲藏于教堂，玷污女神庇...

say:53:1064103035:1.text: Could he be the one who killed Lero?
say:53:1064103035:1.source_cn: 那么，杀害列罗的凶手，有没有可能也是他？

say:55:1064103037:1.source_cn: 是，恩莎村发生了一桩惨案……

narration:56:1064103038:1.text: The two tell Athalia Lero's death in detail.

say:58:1064103040:1.text: Lady Athalia, we humbly seek your aid. Could you, by your divine power, confirm whether Vincenzo is the one who killed Lero? A grieving wife and son beg for your mercy.
say:58:1064103040:1.source_cn: 尊敬的阿塔利娅大人，能否恳请您用神力确认文森佐是否为杀...

say:59:1064103041:1.text: I need to compare the weapon, the wound, and the blood.
say:59:1064103041:1.source_cn: 需要比对凶器、伤口和血液。

narration:62:1064103044:0.text: The acolytes lead Athalia to the side hall.
narration:62:1064103044:0.source_cn: 两位修女带领阿塔利娅来到教堂侧厅

narration:63:1064103045:0.text: Lero's body lies quietly within a coffin.
narration:63:1064103045:0.source_cn: 列罗的遗体静静躺在棺材内

say:65:1064103046:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，这就是那位可怜之人，列罗的遗体。

say:67:1064103048:1.text: Dark magic was cast upon him. One meant to turn a human into a Hypofiend. The same craft the Adamant Syndicate wields.
say:67:1064103048:1.source_cn: 有人曾向他施加过将其转化为魔物的黑魔法，和黑金商会所掌...

say:68:1064103049:1.source_cn: 附近必定藏有其他黑金残党！

say:69:1064103050:1.text: Dura above. How could this be?

say:70:1064103051:1.text: You mean... Syndicate stragglers here in the village? How did they have the chance to use dark magic on him?
say:70:1064103051:1.source_cn: 难道恩莎村还藏着漏网之鱼？！可就算是这样……那个人又是...

say:77:1064103054:1.text: Wh-Where are you going, Lady Athalia?
say:77:1064103054:1.source_cn: 您要去哪里？！阿塔利娅大人！

say:78:1064103055:1.text: Ada, keep with Lady Athalia. Hurry!
say:78:1064103055:1.source_cn: 艾达修女，你快跟上阿塔利娅大人！快，快！

say:5:1064104002:0.text: Wh-Who are you? Don't hurt my Mom!
say:5:1064104002:0.source_cn: 你、你是谁？！你要对我妈妈做什么？！

say:6:1064104003:0.text: Every dark magic wielder needs to be purged.
say:6:1064104003:0.source_cn: 操纵黑魔法的恶徒，必须受到裁决。

say:8:1064104005:1.text: No! My mom's not a bad guy! You're mistaken!
say:8:1064104005:1.source_cn: 不可能！我妈妈才不是坏人！一定是你搞错了！

say:9:1064104006:0.text: And... I don't even know who you are! You're lying!
say:9:1064104006:0.source_cn: 而且……而且你不是恩莎村的人！一定是你在撒谎！

say:11:1064104007:1.source_cn: 艾、艾雅在上……阿塔利娅大人，总算跟上您了！

say:12:1064104008:1.text: Lady Athalia, why her? Eminie is Lero's wife. She's a victim!
say:12:1064104008:1.source_cn: ……您、您为什么要拿武器对准埃米妮？她是列罗的妻子，是...

say:13:1064104009:1.text: The dark magic on his body was her doing.
say:13:1064104009:1.source_cn: 尸体上的黑魔法，是她施加的。

say:14:1064104010:1.text: She has fallen into darkness. A purge is pending.
say:14:1064104010:1.source_cn: 她已堕入邪恶，必须清除。

say:15:1064104011:1.text: Forgive me, Lady Athalia, but that can't be true! Eminie is innocent. Something doesn't add up.
say:15:1064104011:1.source_cn: 黑魔法？不，阿塔利娅大人，埃米妮只是一个无辜的普通人，...

say:16:1064104012:1.text: There is no innocence in the Adamant Syndicate! All who bear its name profane the Goddess.
say:16:1064104012:1.source_cn: 黑金成员全都是亵渎女神的邪恶之徒！何来无辜？！

say:17:1064104013:1.text: Their sins are unforgivable! Only judgment preserves justice!
say:17:1064104013:1.source_cn: 他们犯下的罪行不可饶恕！唯有裁决才可维持正义！

say:18:1064104014:1.text: B-But Eminie can't be one of them! After the war, she hardly ever even left Ensar!
say:18:1064104014:1.source_cn: 黑金商会？可是……可是埃米妮不可能是他们的成员啊！战争...

say:19:1064104015:0.source_cn: 埃米妮，你快向阿塔利娅大人解释一下！

say:22:1064104017:0.text: She is right... It's all my fault...
say:22:1064104017:0.source_cn: 不，她说的没错……所有一切，都是因为我的错……

say:23:1064104018:0.text: I did too much wrong when I was young. And now Lero's death is my price to pay...
say:23:1064104018:0.source_cn: 如果不是我年轻时犯下了那么多罪，我的家人也不会遭到如今...

say:25:1064104019:0.text: Confession changes nothing. Submit to judgment and pay what you owe.
say:25:1064104019:0.source_cn: 你既已认罪，就接受裁决，偿还你的罪孽。

say:26:1064104020:1.text: That's the final mercy from Dura!
say:26:1064104020:1.source_cn: 这是女神恩赐给你的，最后的怜悯——

say:30:1064104022:1.text: Louisa? Careful—your legs... Why did you come running?
say:30:1064104022:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女？！你腿脚不便，怎么还是赶过来了？

say:32:1064104023:1.text: Please hear me out, Lady Athalia. Eminie did join the Adamant Syndicate once, but she did it to survive.
say:32:1064104023:1.source_cn: 尊敬的阿塔利娅大人，请听我一言：埃米妮确实曾加入过黑金...

say:33:1064104024:0.text: During the Second Divine War more than a decade ago, Ensar was hit by brutal Hypofiend raids. Supplies ran dry...
say:33:1064104024:0.source_cn: 十几年前，第二次神魔大战期间，恩莎村遭受了魔物的猛烈攻...

say:34:1064104025:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate was the only one that could get us food and necessities. But they charged a fortune. People sold off their homes and still couldn't buy enough to last.
say:34:1064104025:1.source_cn: 在那样的情况下，能为我们提供粮食和生活物资的只有黑金商...

say:35:1064104026:1.text: Without Eminie taking that risk and finding us ways to make money, Ensar would've been wiped off the map long ago...
say:35:1064104026:1.source_cn: 如果不是埃米妮冒险加入黑金商会，帮大家寻找赚钱的机会，...

say:36:1064104027:1.text: Yes, she's guilty of wrongs. But she's no monster, Lady Athalia.
say:36:1064104027:1.source_cn: 我不会否认埃米妮曾犯下过种种罪孽，但恳求您相信，她绝非...

say:37:1064104028:0.text: She cut ties with the Adamant Syndicate once the war ended. She started a family with Lero and barely left the village for fear of bringing danger to them.
say:37:1064104028:0.source_cn: 而且，战争结束后埃米妮便与黑金彻底断绝了来往。和列罗结...

say:40:1064104030:0.text: Lady Athalia... I'm begging you. She broke free from the Adamant Syndicate years ago. For that alone, please show her mercy.
say:40:1064104030:0.source_cn: 尊敬的阿塔利娅大人，我恳求您，看在她早已脱离黑金的份上...

say:41:1064104031:0.text: Yet, she still uses dark magic!

say:42:1064104032:1.text: They loved each other deeply, so his death came as a great shock. She tried to revive him with a dark magic potion the Syndicate once gave her.
say:42:1064104032:1.source_cn: 埃米妮与列罗感情甚笃，她只是一时无法接受列罗的离去，才...

say:43:1064104033:1.text: Besides, the potion failed. That alone proves she has no ties to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:43:1064104033:1.source_cn: 可是您看，黑魔法药剂并没有生效，这足以说明埃米妮和黑金...

say:44:1064104034:1.source_cn: 我再次恳求您——请您宽恕埃米妮的罪孽！

say:46:1064104036:1.text: Dura withdrew from this world only ten short years ago and already mortals have forgotten. Forgotten that the Syndicate conspired with the Hypogeans who waged the war.
say:46:1064104036:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神不再降临于世不过短短十年，凡人便忘却了当年的仇...

say:47:1064104037:1.text: This is blasphemy. Betrayal! It will not be forgiven.
say:47:1064104037:1.source_cn: ——这是对女神的亵渎与背叛！绝不可原谅！

say:48:1064104038:1.text: And you, who serves the Goddess, should not lend your voice to shield the guilty.
say:48:1064104038:1.source_cn: 你身为侍奉女神的修女，亦不该为罪人发言！

say:53:1064104041:1.text: N-No...! No one's going to hurt my mom! Not even Lady Athalia! *Crying*
say:53:1064104041:1.source_cn: 不，不行……谁也不能伤害我妈妈！就算是传说中的阿塔利娅...

say:55:1064104042:1.text: Lady Athalia, please don't! It goes against the Temple's creed!
say:55:1064104042:1.source_cn: ……阿塔利娅大人，您不能这样做！这有违圣堂的教义！

say:56:1064104043:1.text: To purge evil and uphold justice. That is exactly Dura's words!
say:56:1064104043:1.source_cn: 裁决邪恶，维护正义——这正是艾雅女神示下神谕！

say:57:1064104044:1.text: The words are for you and the other Celestials. But the Temple was built on something else.
say:57:1064104044:1.source_cn: 这是艾雅女神传达给您和诸位半神的神谕，但圣堂最重要的教...

say:58:1064104045:1.text: The Goddess raised the Temple to shelter mortals in suffering.
say:58:1064104045:1.source_cn: 女神建立圣堂，是为了给遭遇苦难的凡人提供庇护。

say:59:1064104046:1.text: Not only for refugees who lost everything to war... but for people like Eminie, too—people pushed onto the wrong path.
say:59:1064104046:1.source_cn: 这些人里，不止因为战争而失去亲人、流离失所的难民……也...

say:60:1064104047:1.text: You're right. The Adamant Syndicate has committed blasphemy, and Eminie is no exception. But it's also true she brought supplies to Ensar and that's what kept the Temple running, so we could protect more lives!
say:60:1064104047:1.source_cn: 如您所说，黑金成员都做过亵渎女神之事，埃米妮也不例外。...

say:61:1064104048:1.text: The Divine War tore the land apart. As a refugee, I was rejected by most of the towns, which struggled to even protect themselves...
say:61:1064104048:1.source_cn: 十年前大地上炮火连天，我逃难时路过了许多村镇，其中绝大...

say:62:1064104049:1.text: Only Ensar, and the temple here, took in refugees like me. They gave us food, blankets, and a place to sleep.
say:62:1064104049:1.source_cn: 只有恩莎村，只有这里的教堂，收留了很多像我这样的难民，...

say:63:1064104050:1.text: I believe Eminie had a hand in that. Louisa said it herself. Without Eminie, Ensar might not have held on until the war ended.
say:63:1064104050:1.source_cn: 我想，这其中一定有埃米妮的功劳！路易莎修女也说过，如果...

say:64:1064104051:1.text: And for the ten years after that, she gave what she could to every temple effort.
say:64:1064104051:1.source_cn: 而且战争结束后的十年里，埃米妮一直非常虔诚，不论教堂举...

say:65:1064104052:1.text: She always remains a devotee of Dura. She chose to save more people, even if it meant going against what she believed and walking beside the Adamant Syndicate.
say:65:1064104052:1.source_cn: 她对女神的信仰从未改变，只是为了遵从圣堂的教义、拯救更...

say:66:1064104053:1.text: To me... that's an act of kindness and a sacrifice, too. One that tears at the soul. Otherwise, she wouldn't have carried this guilt until today.
say:66:1064104053:1.source_cn: 在我看来……这同样是一种牺牲，一种内心饱受煎熬的牺牲。...

say:69:1064104055:1.text: L-Lady Athalia! I don't know if my mom did bad things before... but she never betrayed Dura!
say:69:1064104055:1.source_cn: 阿、阿塔利娅大人，我不知道我妈妈有没有做过坏事……但是...

say:70:1064104056:1.text: Mom always told me to follow the acolytes' example and serve Dura wholeheartedly!
say:70:1064104056:1.source_cn: 妈妈一直教导我，要我跟着修士修女们多多学习，好好侍奉女神。

say:71:1064104057:1.text: Whenever I made a mistake, no matter how small, she'd send me to the temple to confess and ask Dura for forgiveness...
say:71:1064104057:1.source_cn: 每次我犯了错，就算只是不小心害朋友划伤了手，她都会要求...

say:72:1064104058:1.text: My mom... She's really a good person...
say:72:1064104058:1.source_cn: 我妈妈，她真的不是坏人……

say:73:1064104059:1.text: P-Please forgive her... I'll confess to Dura every day... *Sobbing*
say:73:1064104059:1.source_cn: 求求您，原谅她，我会每天都向女神忏悔的……呜呜呜呜……

say:74:1064104060:1.text: No, Kirako. My poor child. It's all Mom's fault.
say:74:1064104060:1.source_cn: 不……吉拉科，我可怜的孩子……都是妈妈的错……

say:75:1064104061:1.text: Remember what I said? You need to take the consequences of your actions... Mom did a lot of bad things. It's time to pay the price...
say:75:1064104061:1.source_cn: 还记得妈妈曾经教过你的吗？做错了事就要承担后果……妈妈...

say:76:1064104062:1.text: I will grant you three chances.

say:77:1064104063:1.text: One for serving the Adamant Syndicate. One for using dark magic.
say:77:1064104063:1.source_cn: 为黑金效力，第一次。使用黑魔法，第二次。

say:78:1064104064:1.text: Should there be a third, judgment will fall.
say:78:1064104064:1.source_cn: 若再有下一次，裁决必将降临。

say:79:1064104065:1.source_cn: 您……您愿意宽恕我的罪孽……？

say:80:1064104066:1.text: You have not taken a life. You aided the Temple. A cruel war that drove mortals to desperate acts.
say:80:1064104066:1.source_cn: 你没有杀过人。你帮助了圣堂。战争很残酷，凡人过得艰难。

say:82:1064104068:1.text: Those like you may be forgiven three times.
say:82:1064104068:1.source_cn: 和你相像的人，犯错不超过三次，可以宽恕。

say:84:1064104069:1.text: Lady Athalia, maybe we should take every individual circumstance into account.
say:84:1064104069:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，每个人的情况都不同，或许不能这样算……

say:85:1064104070:1.text: I have no time to hear every villain's tale and decide whether their suffering excuses their sin.
say:85:1064104070:1.source_cn: 我没有时间听完每个恶徒的故事，无法判断他们有无苦衷。

say:86:1064104071:1.text: To me, evil must be purged. Three chances are a rare generosity.
say:86:1064104071:1.source_cn: 在我看来，每个恶徒都该受到裁决，无论罪行多少。三次机会...

say:90:1064104074:1.text: Sorry, but I have to finish, Louisa.
say:90:1064104074:1.source_cn: ……抱歉，路易莎修女，我必须说完。

say:92:1064104075:1.text: I have a proposal that may help you, Lady Athalia.
say:92:1064104075:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，我有一个提议，也许能够帮到您。

say:93:1064104076:1.text: Have a few faithful followers at your side and let their counsel guide your verdicts. That way, you can consider every angle and act with true fairness.
say:93:1064104076:1.source_cn: 如果您能将一些忠诚于女神的信徒带在身边，以他们的意见作...

say:94:1064104077:1.text: With their help, your hunt for evil would be swifter and far more effective.
say:94:1064104077:1.source_cn: 有了他们的协助，铲除邪恶之徒的行动也能事半功倍。

say:97:1064104080:1.text: Dura above. Thank you for your mercy and grace.
say:97:1064104080:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……感恩您的宽容与仁慈！

say:1:1064105001:1.text: ...And that's everything about the day Lady Athalia came to Ensar.
say:1:1064105001:1.source_cn: ……讲到这里，阿塔利娅大人降临我们恩莎村的故事就结束了。

say:2:1064105002:1.text: What a kind and strong Celestial!
say:2:1064105002:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人真是一位又善良又厉害的半神呀……

say:3:1064105003:1.text: Oh, what happened to Ada after that? I haven't seen her in the village.
say:3:1064105003:1.source_cn: 对了，路易莎奶奶，艾达修女后来去哪了？她好像不在我们村子里。

say:4:1064105004:1.text: Ah... Ada joined the Purger of Sins and became one of Lady Athalia's most trusted. She stays active in serving as a measure of her judgement.
say:4:1064105004:1.source_cn: 艾达修女呀……她加入了阿塔利娅大人治下的执刃修女团，作...

say:5:1064105005:1.text: I just got a letter from her. She said they helped Lady Athalia foil a group of villains' plot.
say:5:1064105005:1.source_cn: 前段时间她还有写信回来，说她们协助阿塔利娅大人破坏了一...

say:6:1064105006:1.text: Wow! That's amazing! Could you tell me more about that?
say:6:1064105006:1.source_cn: 哇！好厉害！路易莎奶奶可以给我讲这个故事吗？

say:7:1064105007:1.text: Of course. But not now. You need to go home. Your father's here to pick you up.
say:7:1064105007:1.source_cn: 当然可以。不过现在，你得回家了，你爸爸已经来接你了。

say:9:1064105008:0.text: Dear, time to go. Don't make Louisa tire herself out.
say:9:1064105008:0.source_cn: 小安娜，该回家了，不要总是给路易莎奶奶添麻烦。

say:10:1064105009:0.text: Oh, nonsense. Anna's always been a good girl.
say:10:1064105009:0.source_cn: 呵呵，没这回事。小安娜一向很听话。

say:13:1064105012:1.text: Alright, before we go, there's one more thing.
say:13:1064105012:1.source_cn: 好了，回家之前还有一件事要做，是什么？

say:14:1064105013:1.text: Pray to Dura! I remember everything Grandma taught me!
say:14:1064105013:1.source_cn: ——向艾雅女神祈祷！奶奶说的每句话我都记得很清楚！

say:15:1064105014:1.text: Dad and I are now going to the temple, Louisa. Bye-bye!
say:15:1064105014:1.source_cn: 路易莎奶奶，我和爸爸去教堂里祷告了，再见！

say:18:1064105016:1.text: Dura above. I'm grateful for your mercy and shelter...
say:18:1064105016:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，感恩您的慈悲与庇佑……

say:19:1064105017:1.text: And your mercy on Eminie and her family.
say:19:1064105017:1.source_cn: ……也感恩您对埃米妮一家的宽恕，与救赎。
